Address-sharing statistics for a compiled reference

Source: R/md-places.R
md_addr_freq.Rd

npnormalize::np_addr_freq(), over exactly the rows of a compiled reference: records per address, per address and suite, distinct suites per address, suite coverage, distinct names and the top name's share, and the class. md_publish() ships it in every bundle as addr_freq.parquet, so a run against a slice of the reference (a state, a shard) still reads the whole tier's counts, and md_reference() returns it as addr_freq, the object np_compare(addr_freq = ) takes.

Usage

md_addr_freq(ref, share_min = 10L, unit_coverage_min = 0.5)

Arguments

ref

A compiled reference frame (street_key, zip5, name_key, and street_unit_id or street_unit).

share_min, unit_coverage_min

npnormalize's thresholds.

Value

An object of class np_addr_freq.
